first_prompt:
Segment every instance of: Qb: Short-haired white cat with faint silver shading, round face and blue-green eyes.
Appearance: A compact, cobby short-haired cat (British Shorthair type). Coat is dense, plush and short, nearly white overall with light silver-grey shading along the back and flanks. The tail is shorter and thinner than Qbo's, with faint grey rings and a darker grey tip. Round head with full cheeks, small rounded ears with pink insides. Large, round aqua / blue-green eyes with dark rims, a small pink nose and pink paw pads. Body outline is smooth and clean because the fur is short.
Look for: Cool white to light silver colour, no warm cream or brown tones; Smooth, sharp body outline (short fur, no fluffy halo); Thin tail with grey rings or a grey tip, often carried upright when walking.
This query is for one identity only: Qb (label id 0). Segment only cats that match this description; ignore other cats, people, toys, blankets, and furniture.
